paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption: : Coverage.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between number of completions and coverage for several models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 20 to 28, with tick labels displayed at powers of 2 (20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28). The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and ranges from 0.3 to 0.8 on a linear scale, with no explicit tick labels. A blue solid line with circle markers represents "Llama-3B," starting at a value of approximately 0.36 at x = 20 and reaching a value of approximately 0.79 at x = 28. A light green dashed line with triangle markers indicates "Llama-3B + FT," starting at roughly 0.34 at x = 20, increasing to approximately 0.78 at x = 28. A pale blue solid line with diamond markers represents "Llama-1B," beginning at a value of approximately 0.33 at x = 20 and increasing toward a value of approximately 0.76 at x = 28. A light green dashed line with triangle markers depicts "Llama-1B + FT," starting at approximately 0.32 at x = 20 and ending at approximately 0.75 at x = 28.
